e159g_loso_tilt_vs_current_heldout_ll.classification_evidence: No positive control and no admissible closing ground; 6 of 9 folds positive; interval is fold-normal approximation (inferred).
e159g_loso_tilt_vs_current_heldout_ll.description: Held-out Bernoulli log-lik of conv and sack outcomes under kernel-weighted candidates (K=200, 54000 queries), LOSO refit AO/AD and LO/LD v current in-sample constants; mean per-fold gain in nats.
e159g_loso_tilt_vs_current_heldout_ll.notes: Gain is tiny per play (0.0003 nats); main finding is current sack AO -1.99 over-transfers offense rate SD (.0145 v real .0080) while LOSO -0.35 gives .0090.
e159g_loso_tilt_vs_current_heldout_ll.plain_summary: Refitting the rate tilt out of season shrinks the sack gain about fivefold with slightly better held-out fit.
